retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait of a male figure in western attire against a weathered wooden structure, featuring large serif typography that overlaps the subject's torso.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a smiling man wearing a black cowboy hat and dark shirt, positioned in front of a weathered gray wooden barn wall. The lighting is moody with a blue-tinted shadow cast, and large, semi-transparent serif text is layered across the mid-section of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Text layered in front of the subject's chest and arms
Cool blue color cast unifying the dark clothing and rustic background
High contrast between the white/light blue text and the dark shirt
coreInvariants: Black cowboy hat with decorative band
Weathered vertical wooden planks in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, head and torso filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hat, framed by the dark shirt and background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the large text across the chest, then to the hands at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight framing with minimal negative space, mostly occupied by the textured wooden wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal (clothing and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool slate blue and muted gray (background and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a heavy emphasis on dark values and cool temperature.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
Large x-height for the lowercase letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning causing slight overlaps between characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Small lowercase serif subtitle placed above the main display name.
graphicDevices: Color blocking within text (alternating white and blue)

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with sharp terminals.
Standard serif structure that matches the traditional feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and dark shirt sitting against a weathered gray barn wall with cool blue lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large serif text across the center-bottom of the image, using a mix of white and light blue fill with a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the cowboy hat clearly defined?
Does the text overlap the subject's torso?
Is the color palette predominantly cool and dark?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color cast
Amount of text overlap on the subject
Weathering level of the wooden background
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Change the specific text content while maintaining the serif style

mustAchieve: Professional studio-style lighting on the face

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the dark shirt
Ensure the cowboy hat does not cast an unflattering shadow on the face
Verify the cool-toned color grading is consistent across the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in Western attire + Weathered wood background + Cool blue low-key lighting + Large overlapping serif typography.
